$comment: How each University of Sindh course sits in HEC's notified 'Revised Curriculum for Degree Programs in Education' (2025). A cited reference only: Constitution Art. II still makes the Sindh scheme and guides decide what is taught. Deliberately a separate file: catalog/courses.json, Scheme-and-Course-guides/ and course-overview.mdx are bound review inputs. 'page' is the booklet's printed page; PDF page = page + document.pdf_page_offset. 'text' is verbatim HEC wording and is checked against specs/hec-curriculum-2025/booklet.txt by tests/unit/hec-curriculum.test.mjs. 'status' comes from specs/hec-curriculum-2025/crosswalk.md: only 'covered' outcomes appear on the site. 'relation': named = HEC names this course in the scheme or course list; suggested = HEC names a category and this subject as a suggestion or example; pool = from HEC's suggested interdisciplinary list.

outcomes.text: Examine the cognitive, emotional, and social development of learners and its impact on educational practices and demonstrate an appreciation for the role of psychological principles in education by reflecting on personal learning experiences and adapting teaching practices accordingly.

outcomes.text_ur: اساتذہ کی پیشہ واریت اور جواب دہی کی اہمیت کا تجزیہ کرنا۔
